recovered: The hash was never written down. It survived as a sentence in commit 7d61792 and as a balance in refund-56.json that agreed with it — every other mainnet claim here carries a hash a reader can open, and the one on the venue this project is built around did not. Recovered by scanning the token's Transfer logs to the operator in the blocks before `fund`, then read back: receipt status 1, the router is theirs, the selector is the function the script builds, and the amount is the one the escrow record already implied to the wei.
subject: the one PancakeSwap transaction this project has sent
what_it_is_not: A liquidity position. Nothing in this project has ever minted, collected or burned a PancakeSwap v3 position on mainnet — that is gated in code at BROADCAST_CHAIN = 97 and is on the ledger. This is a v2 swap, and it is the whole of our write history on their contracts.
why: The ERC-8183 payment token had been recorded as unobtainable — 'owner-minted with no faucet, so no wallet here can hold any'. It trades on PancakeSwap. This swap is what falsified that, and it is what funded job 56681's escrow on mainnet.
